title: Italian Pasta Making in San Francisco (Includes 4-Course Meal)
includes: Elegant San Francisco venue with hands-on instruction
Full 4-course menu with antipasti, pasta, chicken and dessert
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Immerse yourself in the artistry of Italian cuisine in San Francisco, hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to a small group, this hands-on class with a five-star pasta chef blends refined flavors, traditional recipes and modern presentation.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Antipasti with marinated vegetables, cured meats and cheeses
- Handmade pasta with slow-simmered beef sauce
- Chicken piccata with lemon, pancetta and greens
- Grilled peaches with honey and mascarpone cream

Learn kneading, rolling, sauce-making and plating techniques while enjoying authentic Italian dishes in an intimate, relaxed setting.
